name: Discogs-Bot
tagline: Works your Discogs collection, wantlist and marketplace from a signed-in session
description: Built for record collectors who spend longer in Discogs tabs than at the turntable. From your own logged-in session it searches releases, keeps the collection and wantlist tidy, reads current listings and asking prices, and can drop a record in the cart, replaying the site's own calls rather than clicking pages.
author: Alexandre
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
